thread.title: Apple stock gains after Loop Capital turns more bullish - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple stock gains after Loop Capital turns more bullish - MarketWatch
text:
Published: July 6, 2018 10:52 a.m. ET Share
By Emily Bary
Loop Capital analyst Ananda Baruah raised his price target on shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.11% to $210 from $195 on Friday, writing that the stock seems well positioned for the rest of the year. "Specifically, we believe the combination of ongoing Services momentum (which we believe to be structural) and the introduction of a lower-ASP [average-selling-price] LCD-based iPhone X (upon the September launch of iPhone X Version 2, or Xv2) can provide tailwind to both revenue and iPhone X units that wasn't present for the iPhone Xv1 launch," Baruah wrote. He is upbeat about Apple's ability to retain a favorable mix of high-priced phones in the second half of the calendar year. Apple shares are up 0.7% in Friday trading and up 31% over the past 12 months. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.58% of which Apple is a component, has gained 14% in that time.
